tasks.title: Newsletter form with consent
tasks.statement: Build a form posting to `/newsletter` with a labelled email field, a required consent checkbox and a submit button.
tasks.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Newsletter</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="/newsletter" method="post">
    <label for="email">Email</label>
    <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required>
    <label>
      <input type="checkbox" name="consent" value="yes" required>
      I agree to receive the newsletter
    </label>
    <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
tasks.expected:
Email [____________]
I agree to receive the newsletter (checkbox)
Subscribe

tasks.title: Booking form with date and time
tasks.statement: Create a form with a labelled date input, a labelled time input and a labelled number input for guests, minimum 1 and maximum 6.
tasks.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Booking</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="/book" method="post">
    <label for="date">Date</label>
    <input id="date" name="date" type="date" required>
    <label for="time">Time</label>
    <input id="time" name="time" type="time" required>
    <label for="guests">Guests</label>
    <input id="guests" name="guests" type="number" min="1" max="6" value="2">
    <button type="submit">Book</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
tasks.expected:
Date [dd/mm/yyyy]
Time [--:--]
Guests [2]

debug.title: A radio group with no legend
debug.broken:
<fieldset>
  <label><input type="radio" name="year" value="1"> First</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="year" value="2"> Second</label>
</fieldset>
debug.fix:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Year</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="year" value="1"> First</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="year" value="2"> Second</label>
</fieldset>
debug.error: Missing legend: the group has no accessible name, so a screen-reader user hears two options without knowing what they choose between.

tasks.title: Progressive form with a JS hook
tasks.statement: Build a form that posts normally, a submit button carrying `data-submit`, and a deferred script.
tasks.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <script src="js/app.js" defer></script>
  <title>Progressive form</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="/save" method="post">
    <label for="title">Title</label>
    <input id="title" name="title" type="text">
    <button type="submit" data-submit="save">Save</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
tasks.expected:
Title [____________]
Save (works with or without the script)
